speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked	the Acting Minister for Education (Schools) whether the revamped social studies syllabus, and/or other elements in the primary and/or secondary school curriculum, will provide detailed explanations for why ballot secrecy is inviolate in elections.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I think the Minister for his helpful reply.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Can you please put forth your question, Mr Perera?

speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: So, in the context of the fact that there could be a minority of Singaporeans who are exercised about this issue and are concerned about ballot secrecy, would the Minister consider asking MOE to include a brief or a limited element of training about ballot secrecy within the Social Studies curriculum, given that it seems to be an issue that exercises a minority of Singaporeans, although it does not exercise the majority?

speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
text: Voting is an issue that concerns all Singaporeans.
